verdict.rationale: Google Workspace publishes REST API reference pages, such as Directory users.list and the Reports API reference. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer, a 'try it' console, or runnable examples on those pages. Probes for machine-readable OpenAPI specs and llms.txt also returned 404, so the evidence documents only static reference material, which does not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
